messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Staged implementation timeline + responsibility roster (Prairie Health)

Hi Beth / Jamal —

Thanks again for the time today. Per our conversation I attached an initial staged Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a short risk heatmap to make sure we align on scope, owners, and hard dates. This is intentionally conservative — we want to lock the dates you need for the pilot while leaving a small buffer for procurement and test data prep.

Quick summary of the three-stage plan in the spreadsheet:
- Stage A (Pilot): sandbox access, ingestion test, baseline evals — target window: Dec 6–17
- Stage B (Pilot expansion + approvals): performance tuning, integrations, security review — Jan 4–28
- Stage C (Prod roll): go-live cutover, runbooks, SLO monitoring — Feb 8–12

Key asks for Prairie:
1) Provide list of pilot users and sample dataset by Nov 27
2) Procurement to confirm SOW redlines by Dec 3 (I copied procurement in case that helps)
3) Tech contact available for weekly 30-min sync starting Nov 30

Internal owners (first pass in the workbook):
- Redwood CS lead: Marissa Cole — overall onboarding cadence and adoption plan
- Redwood Solutions Eng: Rishi Malhotra — ingestion, model selection, performance tuning
- Redwood Ops: Ben Carter — infra provisioning for Dedicated pool (if selected)

Attachments: Prairie_MAP_v1.xlsx (with milestone table), Prairie_Risk_Heatmap.pdf

I left comment cells where I need your confirmation. If these milestones look reasonable I’ll convert to a mutual timeline in HubSpot and schedule the first sprint sync for Nov 30 at 10am PT.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com

- Procurement is reviewing the SOW; they requested a revised timeline that shifts the SOW sign date to Dec 10 to allow legal to triage redlines.
- We prefer pilot start Dec 13 (gives us one week to ingest the samples and sanity-check).

I copied procurement so they can reply on the SOW timing. Also tagging Jamal to confirm the technical contact for the project.

Beth —

Nov 30 sync at 10am PT works for us. I’ll own the run-of-show and the sprint roster for Stage A. Action items I’ll take on before the sync:
- Populate the pilot user roster template in the attached MAP (I filled in columns G–I)
- Draft a 3-week sprint plan for Stage A with daily dev/QA checkpoints and acceptance criteria
- Coordinate with Ben on infra lead time for the Dedicated pool (Ben: can you confirm earliest node-ready date?)

Ben: please flag any infra lead time that would push the pilot beyond Dec 13 (Beth’s requested start). If Dedicated capacity is not required for initial pilot we can start on sandbox.

I also added a short column in the MAP labeled "escalation path" so we have a named contact for each risk.

Thanks — looking forward to the sync.

Quick technical addendum:
- Ingestion checklist: we need sample schema, expected per-user daily volume, and retention window. If Jamal can drop a sanitized sample file to the Drive link before Nov 27 that’ll accelerate validation.
- Model variance: recommend we start with the Llama-3 family quantized variant for pilot to reduce cost and speed up inference; I logged estimated token-costs in the MAP comments.
- Contingency: if we hit higher latency during pilot we should pivot to a small Dedicated pool for the pilot load during Stage A — Ben, please advise on 48–72h provisioning SLA for a 2-node pool.

I updated the MAP with technical acceptance criteria and a short runbook stub under the Stage A tab.

-Rishi

Confirming next steps and owners before the Nov 30 sync:
- Jamal: deliver sanitized sample dataset to the Drive folder by Nov 27 (owner)
- Procurement (procurement@prairiehealth.com): finalize SOW redlines by Dec 3 (owner)
- Marissa: distribute Stage A sprint plan and invite the pilot roster to Nov 30 sync (owner)
- Rishi: finalize technical acceptance criteria and attach runbook stub to the MAP (owner)
- Ben: advise on Dedicated pool 48–72h provisioning ETA and list any blocking approvals (owner)

I’ve created a HubSpot timeline entry and linked the MAP (see HubSpot deal in related links). I also uploaded SOW_v0.9.docx to the Drive and sent DocuSign placeholder to procurement to speed signature once redlines are resolved. If procurement needs alternate routing please flag.

Proposed fallback if procurement needs extra time: start Stage A in a sandbox environment Dec 13 and switch to Dedicated for Stage B (no SOW hold in that scenario). I captured both options in the MAP so we can pick in-sync.

I’ll move the MAP to the shared folder and convert comment items to action cards after the Nov 30 call. See you all then.
